Subject: BrightPath Health — Demo request and qualification

Hi Emily —

Thanks for signing up for a demo and for your interest in Redwood Inference. I saw your request come in and wanted to quickly collect a few details so we can tailor the demo to your team: 

- Primary use case: (e.g., chat/assistant, summarization, extraction, embeddings)
- Expected monthly inference volume (tokens or requests)
- Timeline to production / pilot start date
- Any security/compliance requirements (SOC2, VPC, data residency)

Also: are there any teammates who should join the call? I have availability next week on Tue 3/24 9:00–11:00am PT or Wed 3/25 1:00–4:00pm PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple times that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.

If you already have an RFI or architecture doc, feel free to attach it — that helps our engineers prep.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
SDR, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference
From: Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:18:04 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath Health — Demo request and qualification

Hi Ava — thanks for the quick follow-up. A bit about our situation: 

- Use case: Clinical note summarization and extraction for care coordination; generating patient-friendly summaries from clinician notes.
- Volume: Pilot ~100k tokens/day (roughly 1–2k notes/day), likely scale to 1M+ tokens/day in 3–6 months if pilot is successful.
- Timeline: Pilot kickoff in early April; wider rollout targeted Q3 2026.
- Security: SOC2 is required; we host in AWS and prefer VPC/private deployment for PHI work.

Attaching our RFI (BrightPath-RFI.pdf) — it has more details and a short data flow diagram.

Either of your suggested windows could work; Wed 3/25 2:00pm PT is best for our lead engineer Tom Nguyen and me. Can you invite Tom (tom.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com)?

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Product, BrightPath Health
emily.park@brightpathhealth.com
